# go ka

## Apps

### BeforeGo: AI Itinerary Planner

An AI itinerary planner for iPhone that turns a travel post, link or note into a day-by-day trip plan, and writes the packing list from your destination and dates.

- Page: https://beforego.art/beforego/
- Page (de): https://beforego.art/beforego/de/
- Page (fr): https://beforego.art/beforego/fr/
- Page (it): https://beforego.art/beforego/it/
- Page (es): https://beforego.art/beforego/es/
- Page (es-MX): https://beforego.art/beforego/es-mx/
- Page (pt-BR): https://beforego.art/beforego/pt-br/
- Page (ja): https://beforego.art/beforego/ja/
- Page (ko): https://beforego.art/beforego/ko/
- Page (zh-Hans): https://beforego.art/beforego/zh-hans/
- Page (zh-Hant): https://beforego.art/beforego/zh-hant/
- Page (th): https://beforego.art/beforego/th/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6786561175
- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Category: Travel
- For: People who plan trips from other people's posts and guides, and pack from memory.
- Free: Free to start — no ads, no account required. Premium unlocks everything; a one-time lifetime purchase is also available.

### Countdown Widget: Any Event

A countdown widget app for iPhone where every widget size is free and the number of events is unlimited.

- Page: https://beforego.art/countdown/
- Page (pt-BR): https://beforego.art/countdown/pt-br/
- Page (de): https://beforego.art/countdown/de/
- Page (fr): https://beforego.art/countdown/fr/
- Page (it): https://beforego.art/countdown/it/
- Page (ja): https://beforego.art/countdown/ja/
- Page (ko): https://beforego.art/countdown/ko/
- Page (th): https://beforego.art/countdown/th/
- Page (zh-Hans): https://beforego.art/countdown/zh-hans/
- Page (zh-Hant): https://beforego.art/countdown/zh-hant/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799846628
- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Category: Productivity
- For: Anyone counting down to a trip, wedding, exam, birthday or due date — or counting up from one.
- Free: Every widget size, unlimited events, reminders, repeats, count-up, daily on-device backup, iCloud sync.
- Paid: Pro unlocks 107 of the 159 backdrops, your own photos behind a countdown, the Pro typefaces, the Lock Screen Live Activity and inviting someone to count down with you. Annual plan with a 7-day free trial, monthly plan, or a one-time Lifetime purchase; prices are shown in the app before purchase.

### Smart Invoice & Estimate Maker

An iPhone invoice app that makes invoices, estimates and receipts as PDFs, with a scan-to-pay QR code on the invoice.

- Page: https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/
- Page (de): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/de/
- Page (fr): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/fr/
- Page (it): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/it/
- Page (es): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/es/
- Page (es-MX): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/es-mx/
- Page (pt-BR): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/pt-br/
- Page (ja): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/ja/
- Page (ko): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/ko/
- Page (zh-Hant): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/zh-hant/
- Page (th): https://beforego.art/invoiceqr/th/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790383156
- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Category: Business
- For: Freelancers, contractors and small businesses who bill from their phone rather than a desktop accounting suite.
- Free: Your first document — one in total, not one a month, whether it's an invoice, an estimate or a quote; editing or re-sending it is free — plus four of the ready-made QR designs.
- Paid: Pro: unlimited invoices and QR exports, 100+ invoice templates, 12+ QR styles and 16+ ready-made designs, a full brand kit, custom QR colours, dots and frames, and no app line at the foot of exports.

### DailyCalorie: Calories Left

An AI photo calorie counter for iPhone that shows what you can still eat today rather than what you already ate.

- Page: https://beforego.art/dailycalorie/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6798095407
- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Category: Health & Fitness
- For: People who quit other calorie apps because logging every item by hand was too slow.
- Free: 3 photo recognitions, full history and trends, the month calendar, the eating window, meals, exercise and the weight log.
- Paid: Pro, monthly or yearly (the yearly plan begins with a 7-day free trial): unlimited photo recognition, protein/carb/fat targets for every meal, a custom goal weight and pace, and CSV export.

### Custom QR Code Maker & Scan

An iPhone QR code generator and scanner that lets you style a code with colours, shapes and a logo without breaking it.

- Page: https://beforego.art/qrcodestudio/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799589471
- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Category: Utilities
- For: Anyone putting a QR code on a menu, poster, business card or shop window and wanting it to look like it belongs there.
- Free: Making and scanning all twelve kinds of code, with the standard styles.
- Paid: QR Studio Pro, monthly or yearly (7-day free trial for new yearly subscribers): every illustrated scene, every frame and shape, gradients, custom colours and your own logo in the middle.

### 单词兽-拍照学单词·小学初中英语闯关

拍照学单词、闯关背单词的 iPhone app：1,671 个单词和句子排成 271 关，覆盖小学到初中常用词汇。

- Page: https://beforego.art/citu/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6796596826
- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Category: Education
- For: 学英语单词的小学、初中学生和家长。
- Free: 前 8 关、最近 7 天的错题复习、「拍拍」共 3 次、2 套基础换装与奖励。
- Paid: VIP（按月或按年自动续订，权益相同，支持家人共享）：全部 271 关、「拍拍」每天 50 次、完整错题本、熟练度分布、家长周报、iCloud 多设备同步。价格在确认购买前显示。

### Repdex: Gym Workout Tracker

A gym workout log for iPhone.

- Page: https://beforego.art/repdex/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6803828068
- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad)
- Category: Health & Fitness
- For: People logging strength training sessions.
- Free: All 1,324 exercises, all 10 instruction languages and unlimited workout logging; your history is never locked.
- Paid: Repdex Pro, monthly, yearly (7-day free trial for new subscribers) or a one-time Lifetime purchase: unlimited routines, advanced stats, CSV export and home-screen widgets.

## FAQ

### What is go ka?

go ka is an independent developer making small iPhone apps for everyday things: a countdown widget, an AI trip planner, an invoice maker, a photo calorie counter, a QR code maker, an English vocabulary app for kids, a gym workout tracker and a baby memory book. All eight are published on the App Store under one developer account.

### Are the apps free?

All eight apps are free to download and can be used without paying. Extra features come with an optional subscription, and some apps also offer a one-time purchase. The price is always shown in the app before you confirm.

### Do I need to create an account?

No. None of the apps asks you to sign up or create an account. Where an app syncs between your devices, it uses your own iCloud.

### Which devices do the apps run on?

iPhone and iPad. Seven of the apps need iOS 17 or later; DailyCalorie needs iOS 18 or later.

### Which languages are the apps available in?

Countdown, BeforeGo, Invoice Maker, DailyCalorie, Word Beast and Pagewren are available in 10 or more languages, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Thai. QR Studio and Repdex are in English.

### How do I get help with one of the apps?

Email qinqiangji@gmail.com and say which app it is about. Every message is read. Each app also has its own page on this site with its privacy policy and terms.

## Notes

- Every app is free to download. Paid parts, where there are any, are listed on each app's page.
- No app asks for an account or sign-up. Where an app syncs, it uses the user's own iCloud.
- Support and feedback: qinqiangji@gmail.com
